title: My kitten at 8 months is almost the size of an adult cat
author: boney_robin
text: My kitten at 8 months is almost the size of an adult cat and has a massively fluffy tail. Is this humble tuxedo kitty part Maine Coon? This apartment isn't big enough for him!
blurb: At just 8 months, this tuxedo kitten is already nearly adult-cat sized, with a massively fluffy tail, and his human suspects a little Maine Coon in the mix. Here he gazes up with big golden eyes, clearly ready to outgrow the apartment.
